piece: Classical Arabic Orchestra of Aleppo: Samai Bayati. A free-rhythm oud taqsim, then the samai thaqil in a 10-beat cycle for the full takht ensemble (oud, qanun, ney, violin, riq, darabuka), then a faster closing section in 6/8 (samai darij).
questions: the first note of the solo oud improvisation
the moment the full ensemble and the percussion enter together and a regular rhythmic cycle begins
the clearest change of character in the middle of the ensemble music, where a contrasting section begins
the moment the music changes to the faster, lilting closing metre
the last note of the piece
